# Alif Laam Meem Jewellers

> Fine jewellery in 21K gold, made to be worn and treasured. A family jewellery showroom in Al Rehman Square Mall, Al Rehman Garden Phase 2, Sharaqpur, Punjab, Pakistan (on the Lahore side), selling 21K gold bridal sets, necklaces, rings, earrings and bangles. Prices are on request because they follow the daily gold rate.

## Contact
- Address: Shop #8, Alif Laam Meem Jewellers, Al Rehman Square Mall, Al Rehman Garden Phase 2, Sharaqpur, 54000, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 311 481 7882
- Email: aliflaammeemjewellers@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon – Sun  11:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shop+%23+8,+Alif+Laam+Meem+Jewellers,+Al+Rehman+Square+Mall,+Al+Rehman+Garden+Phase+2,+Sharaqpur,+54000,+Pakistan/@31.5999959,74.230572,16z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x39191d5c10f9f201:0x80fa197d42f5b621!8m2!3d31.5999959!4d74.230572!16s%2Fg%2F11mdqhlycb
